sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and strategy. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various obstacles, including deadly explosive barrels that will send you back to the start. Your mission is to collect the required number of points to move to the next level of the mine, where you'll face new challenges and puzzles.

The gameplay is divided into several key elements, including movement, collection, and strategy. Movement is straightforward, with a simple navigation system that allows you to move left, right, up, and down. Collection is where the game gets interesting, as you'll need to carefully select the right items to collect and prioritize your goals. Strategy is key, as you'll need to think ahead and plan your moves carefully to overcome obstacles and reach the next level.

One of the game's greatest strengths is its ability to balance simplicity and complexity.
